moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The huge surf and music festival, Boardmasters, returns to Newquay, Cornwall, bringing major acts and surf action to the south-west coast from Wednesday.

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Newquay is buzzing! Boardmasters kicks off on Wednesday – who are you most excited to see hit the main stage, or are you all about the surf? #Boardmasters

angles.name: Line-up Anticipation
angles.copy: Boardmasters is almost here! Get ready for five days of incredible music and surf in Newquay, starting Wednesday. Who's on your must-see list?

moments.title: Roots Picnic makes UK debut
moments.blurb: The globally celebrated Roots Picnic festival makes its highly anticipated international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8-9.

angles.name: London Festival Vibes
angles.copy: The legendary Roots Picnic hits London's Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend (Aug 8-9) for its first-ever international edition! Who's ready for this slice of hip hop history?

angles.name: Hip Hop History
angles.copy: From Philly to Crystal Palace! Roots Picnic is bringing its unique blend of music and culture to the UK this Saturday and Sunday. Expect world-class performances!

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 Season Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is set to kick off on Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal facing Coventry City, marking the return of top-flight English football.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: It's almost here! The Premier League returns on August 21st. Who are you backing for the title this season?

angles.name: Opening Weekend
angles.copy: Less than three weeks until the Premier League kicks off! Arsenal vs Coventry City on Friday 21st August gets us started. What's your opening weekend prediction?

moments.title: Leeds vs Liverpool Pre-season Friendly
moments.blurb: Leeds United take on Liverpool today in a high-profile pre-season friendly in Chicago, as both teams continue their preparations for the upcoming season.

angles.name: US Pre-season Action

angles.name: Yorkshire Team Abroad
angles.copy: Our Whites are stateside! Leeds United take on Liverpool in Chicago today as pre-season ramps up. How do you think they'll get on?
